_doc: Guild free-text chat filter (13+ chat). Used by the client (Survival.Domain.Kids.ChatFilter, display) and the server (Backend/alliance/src/moderation.mjs, authoritative on send). Words are matched as whole words after lower-casing, simple leetspeak folding (0>o 1>i 3>e 4>a 5>s 7>t @>a $>s) and repeated-letter collapsing, then masked with '*'. Every masked or refused message is copied to the server moderation queue (chat_reports, source='filter'). DEREK / MODERATION OWNER: replace or extend this starter list with a vetted multilingual list (English, Filipino/Tagalog, French for Quebec) or a vendor before launch.
